div.p: Find answers, contact campus support, or share feedback about your student experience.

section.p: Quick answers to common questions about your student account and campus services.

details.summary: How do I correct my official details?
details.div: Open Requests & Certificates and submit a profile / student record correction request. Include the incorrect and correct details and attach supporting evidence if requested. Updates are made only after the authorised office verifies them.

details.summary: Why are my examination results missing?
details.div: Results appear after they are published and linked to your student record. Check the correct assessment or semester filter in Examinations & Results first. If the result is still missing after publication, contact the Examination Cell with your subject and assessment details.

details.summary: How is my attendance percentage calculated?
details.div: Attendance is calculated from attended eligible sessions divided by total eligible sessions for the relevant subject or period. Late sessions count as present and cancelled classes do not count. Excused sessions are excluded from the calculation.Excused sessions count as present.Excused sessions count as absent. Check My Attendance and report any incorrect session through Requests & Certificates. Official rules are determined by the college.

details.summary: Where can I find fee receipts and payment status?
details.div: Go to Fees & Payments and open Payment history & receipts. Use the posted ledger and receipt status to check your payments. If a payment is missing, contact the Accounts Office with the date, amount and transaction reference—never share an OTP or banking password.

details.summary: How do I request a bonafide certificate or transcript?
details.div: Use Requests & Certificates → New request, choose the appropriate document type, state the purpose and deadline, and submit any required supporting details. Submission does not mean the certificate has already been issued.

section.p: Share a suggestion about teaching, facilities, student services or campus life. Feedback is associated with your student account and may be visible to authorised college staff.
section.div: Please do not include passwords, OTPs, confidential payment credentials or unnecessary sensitive personal information.
